_comment: Fixed config for the dedicated power-base project (power_base/, NOT module/) -- see docs/power-base.md. The power base's one physical POGO port is electrically identical to a sensor module's DOWNSTREAM port (same GPIO numbers as module/'s confirmed profile: UART1, GPIO10/11, DETECT_OUT=3, DETECT_IN=23) -- it connects to the first sensor module's UPSTREAM port. BASE_ID is a GND contact on the power-base connector itself, not a GPIO on this board -- there is no base_id field here at all (see docs/pogo-interface.md's BASE_ID section and docs/power-base.md's wiring table).
_downstream_comment: Same UART1/GPIO10-11/DETECT pins as module/'s confirmed DOWNSTREAM profile -- this is what makes the power base electrically a drop-in replacement for 'the module that would otherwise be ROOT'.
_detect_out_comment: DETECT_OUT moved from GPIO22 to GPIO3 (config_revision bumped 1->2, this follow-up) -- GPIO22 is not a convenient header pin on the real ESP32-H2 SuperMini board and required direct soldering with board-damage risk; GPIO3 is header-accessible, an ordinary non-strapping GPIO already allowed by gpio_profile.c, and used here only as an open-drain DETECT_OUT output (never a Deep-sleep wake source, unlike UPSTREAM DETECT_IN=GPIO12 which is unchanged). See docs/pogo-interface.md's GPIO history section.
_timeout_comment: ack_timeout_ms=0 means parent_service uses its own CONFIG_POGO_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS Kconfig default (same value module/ uses) -- set a nonzero value here only if the power base's own POGO handshake genuinely needs a different timeout than a sensor module's. heartbeat_timeout_ms must stay comfortably larger than topology_reporter's own CONFIG_TOPOLOGY_REPORTER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS Kconfig default (30000ms) so ordinary jitter is never mistaken for a real detach.
_power_comment: No power-switching GPIO has been decided on current hardware -- -1 means the 5V rail is assumed always-on; this firmware never claims to be able to cut real 5V power (see docs/power-base.md's safety notes on USB+5V co-connection).
